name: Níjar (Spain)
description: White field with a blue diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Níjar outlined in white (a tower on blue).
history: Níjar obtained its arms by decree in July 1971, but the flag was only admitted in April 2026, when the design presented in May 2025 was accepted; it is a rectangular flag of 2:3, white with a blue bend from the upper hoist corner to the lower fly corner one fifth of the flag's length in width, charged with the municipal arms outlined in white.

features.role: band one fifth of the length from the upper hoist to the lower fly
Níjar arms — tower on blue, outlined white
